property_summary: For any caller and amount, if an account's balance is strictly less than MinSum then a call to Collect(amount) must never transfer ETH out of any account whose balance < MinSum (i.e. the Log-recorder should never observe a Collect call that reduces balance for an account with pre-call balance < MinSum); the mutant removes the MinSum check and thus for some fuzzed inputs the recorder will observe a Collect-triggered payment even though the target account's balance was below MinSum.
change_summary: Replace the conditional that checks balance and unlock time with a weaker check removing the MinSum requirement, allowing collects when balance >= _am even if below MinSum.
